title: The Impact of Manipulated Clinical Decision Support Algorithm on Opioid Prescribing Decision
eligible_reason: Single common treatment date. results.do line 21: did = practice_fusion x (year >= 2016); all treated physicians (Practice Fusion EHR users since 2011) are exposed to the biased CDS from 2016, so there is one adoption cohort. The long-term indicator did_19v13 compares 2019-2021 with 2013-2015 for the same cohort. Figure 2 is an event study of treat x year dummies around 2016. All Table 2 columns also include time-varying beneficiary-mix controls (average age, male, Black and Hispanic shares, risk score, dual-eligible share) and absorb physician and ZIP3-by-year FE. Not a near-miss because the two-cohort rule fails.
